correctness.rationale: Every idempotent is a partial retraction onto its fixed image. Orthogonality is equivalent to two exact image-domain disjointness conditions, yielding the conditional binomial-power degree counts. Exact multiplicities follow by choosing image and domain. The singleton-identity routing establishes diameter at most three, and two codimension-one partial identities with distinct omitted points forbid shorter paths. The degree extremizers are proved through strict neighborhood containment and the positive-degree formula. Independent exhaustive verifiers check exact products, degrees and graph distances in finite cases.

This goes beyond the preexisting global joint-rank counts of orthogonal pairs.
